styles.name: Vox Explainer
styles.inspiration: Vox-style animated documentary / explainer. Paper-collage of old engravings and halftone photos, masked and outlined; high-contrast serif type; one signature yellow shape per beat; hand-drawn arrows; choppy low-shutter stop-motion with camera moves into shallow 3D depth. Reference images in references/.

palette.notes: 5 symbolic colors: warm paper, warm ink, Vox yellow (the eye-magnet), editorial red, cutout orange. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Fraunces (300 + 900 italic) is the statement voice; Archivo is metadata; Caveat is handwritten margin notes only.
